added.title: Senior Product Manager I, Expert Apply
added.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager I, Expert Apply based in United States.

This role offers the opportunity to lead the product strategy for an AI-powered job search automation experience designed to help people navigate the job market more efficiently.

You will own the end-to-end product roadmap, balancing customer needs, business growth, experimentation, and long-term product vision.

A major focus will be developing a mobile-first experience that improves the application funnel, adoption, engagement, and retention.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and other teams in a highly collaborative and globally distributed environment.

The role combines rigorous experimentation, quantitative analysis, qualitative research, and competitive intelligence to guide product decisions.

You will have significant autonomy to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and turn insights into measurable product improvements.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced consumer product leader passionate about AI, growth, and building practical tools that create meaningful outcomes for users.

Accountabilities

Develop and execute a high-impact product roadmap, aligning product priorities with customer needs and broader business objectives.
Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Expert Apply experience, driving continuous improvements and growth initiatives.
Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and leadership to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver product outcomes.
Champion a mobile-first product strategy focused on optimizing the application funnel, increasing adoption and retention, and supporting the launch of a dedicated mobile application.
Design, execute, and interpret rigorous A/B tests across product experiences and marketing channels to identify opportunities for growth.
Collaborate with Email Marketing and other teams to develop retention strategies, including leveraging job alerts and other engagement mechanisms.
Use market trends, competitive analysis, quantitative metrics, and qualitative user research to identify customer needs and translate insights into actionable product features.
Continuously evaluate product performance and use data-driven insights to refine priorities, improve user experiences, and support revenue growth.
Manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail and execution quality.
Communicate product strategy, priorities, results, and trade-offs clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

Requirements

6–10 years of experience in consumer-facing Product Management.
Proven experience owning product strategy and roadmaps for consumer digital products.
Strong expertise in A/B testing, experimentation methodologies, quantitative analysis, and interpreting complex datasets to drive business decisions.
Demonstrated ability to translate customer insights, market trends, competitive intelligence, and product data into actionable product strategies.
Strong understanding of modern technology stacks and the ability to assess technical complexity and effort while partnering effectively with engineering teams.
Exceptional organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience leading initiatives across multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work effectively and autonomously in a globally distributed, remote environment.
Experience with B2C subscription products, job boards, or AI-driven products is preferred.
Passion for AI-powered consumer experiences, experimentation, continuous improvement, and data-driven product development.

Benefits

Competitive salary with location-based ranges of $150,000–$175,000 for most eligible locations.
Salary range of $165,000–$195,000 for San Francisco, New York, and Seattle locations.
Salary range of $155,000–$185,000 for Austin and Chicago locations.
Bi-annual bonus opportunity.
Equity participation.
401(k) plan with company match.
Flexible spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care.
Internet and home office reimbursement.
Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with optional family plans.
Life and long-term disability insurance options.
Mental health support and wellness resources.
Wellness reimbursement for eligible activities and services.
Optional pet insurance.
Flexible paid time off, sick time, and observed holidays.
100% remote, work-from-home position.
Eligible hiring across specified U.S. states and Puerto Rico.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. added.title: Senior Product Manager - Edifecs
added.description:
Overview

The Senior Product Manager – Edifecs
is the liaison between business stakeholders, product management leadership and engineering managers. This role works with these stakeholders to understand current and future needs related to one or more products and/or modules and iteratively develop product features to evolve products based on product roadmap. Senior Product Manager – Edifecs is well versed with working in agile / scrum framework, software development lifecycle and uses this expertise to bridge gap between customer facing product management and engineering / development functions.

Responsibilities

Own the product development lifecycle end-to-end: discovery, requirements, roadmap planning, feature definition, release execution, and post-launch maintenance for a pre-defined product area.
Lead product initiatives focused on healthcare enrollment, including ingestion, validation, transformation, error handling, reconciliation, and downstream system integrations.
Requirements Gathering: Working closely with stakeholders to gather and document product requirements, ensuring that the product meets the needs of both internal and external users.
Translate business and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product specifications.
Sprint / Project Management: Overseeing the entire product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch and beyond. This includes defining sprint / project timelines, managing resources, and coordinating efforts across different teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality products & incremental improvements.
Create and maintain product documentation for features, release notes, conceptual data flows, and product interfaces.
Incorporate a strong design mindset, working closely with UX/UI partners to define intuitive workflows, simplify complex enrollment processes, and ensure solutions are user-centered and easily accessible.
Partner with engineering teams to prioritize backlog, clarify requirements, and maintain product quality across releases.
Collaborate with QA and engineering to ensure robust test coverage and overall product quality.
Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with strong academic performance in Health Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or other quantitative field.
5-8+ years of product management experience.
Strong understanding of healthcare member enrollment processes, including eligibility, enrollment maintenance, reconciliation, and benefits administration for different Lines of Business.
Prior experience working in a product development lifecycle (Agile preferred), including backlog management, roadmap planning, and feature delivery.
Ability to translate technical concepts and complex enrollment workflows into clear business requirements.
Good communication, stakeholder management, interpersonal and cross-functional collaboration skills, including working with offshore team members.
Ability to engage with technical teams (e.g. engineering, client, implementation) to discuss data models, workflows, and system behavior in case of critical production bugs.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Prior experience as Software Engineer.
Prior experience with Edifecs tools or platforms (EAM, SpecBuilder , TM, ENR, XEServer , XEngine ).
Understanding of related EDI transactions (e.g., 834, 999, TA1).
Exposure to member enrollment processes for Group and Medicaid LOBs.
Familiarity with cloud-based architectures and modern integration patterns.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements

Great written and oral communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
High ownership and ability to work independently.
Ability to influence without authority.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.

Working Conditions And Physical Requirements

Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
No adverse environmental conditions are expected.

Base compensation ranges from $115,000 to $140,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 7/2/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 10/2/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

added.title: Sr. Product Manager Education, AI & Professional Development
added.description:
Position Overview

The Senior Product Manager owns the full strategy, roadmap, and business performance for Colibri’s Professional Development suite and AI Professional Development product lines. Operating as a mature individual contributor, this role translates senior-level direction into execution while driving measurable customer and financial outcomes across the entire product lifecycle — from content ideation and production through delivery, learner impact, and long-term value. You will combine deep customer insight, instructional design expertise, and AI-native thinking to build high-impact, scalable learning experiences that advance real estate professionals’ careers in an AI-driven market.

What You'll Do

Own end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for the Professional Development suite and AI Professional Development offerings, with clear accountability for business results (enrollment, revenue, margin, retention, and learner value).
Lead AI-driven product innovation: translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, outcome-oriented learning experiences that are not just conceptual but tool-driven and learner-trusted.
Define and iterate on customer problems, navigate ambiguity, bring clarity to the problem space, and make confident product decisions that deliver meaningful business impact.
Push value across the full product lifecycle — content ideation, production, delivery, and continuous improvement — while elevating instructional design and learner experience.
Own P&L outcomes for the portfolio, including revenue growth, pricing strategy, margin performance, and key metrics such as enrollment, completion, NPS, repeat purchase, and long-term retention.
Master customer signals: build continuous feedback loops, analyze behavioral data and learner insights, and use them to refine strategy and unlock new growth opportunities.
Co-own go-to-market success with marketing, growth, sales, and delivery teams — shaping positioning, packaging, and launch readiness.
Influence without authority across Product, Technology, Content, Marketing, and Delivery functions to align on priorities and deliver scalable results.
Evaluate AI education services for potential acquisition or build (buy-versus-build decisions) and integrate advanced AI tools (including Claude with Model Context Protocol) into workflows.
Ensure responsible, ethical, and effective use of AI in education products, with strong emphasis on quality, reliability, scalability, and learner trust.

What You'll Need To Succeed

5–7+ years of product management experience with proven ownership of strategy, roadmap, and measurable business outcomes (highest priority).
Demonstrated success launching and scaling education, EdTech, or curriculum-based products.
Must-have instructional design experience and deep understanding of learning theory, interactive course elements, and the full course lifecycle from ideation to production.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills; ability to influence product, content, marketing, and technology teams without direct authority.
Experience owning or materially influencing P&L, pricing, financial forecasting, and business-focused product decisions (growth/business PM orientation, not purely technical).
Proven ability to explore ambiguous problem spaces, read and act on customer signals, and keep the customer at the center of every decision.
Daily applied experience with AI tools in product workflows (especially Claude with integrated data sources and Model Context Protocol / MCP).
Self-motivated ownership mentality; comfortable navigating uncertainty, synthesizing market/performance/customer data, and making high-judgment calls independently.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or ongoing learning in product management, AI, or professional education preferred.
Familiarity with real estate professional education or career development models is a plus.

updated.title: Senior Inbound Product Manager, CRM Voice AI
updated.description:
Full-time
Employee Type: Regular
Region: AMS - North America and Canada
Work Persona: Flexible or Remote

Company Description

About the Team:

CRM Voice AI builds autonomous voice agents for customer service that resolve customer interactions end-to-end and drive significant value for the business. We're a team inside ServiceNow's CRM business unit, shipping production voice AI with enterprise customers today and scaling aggressively. Our agents run on a real-time streaming pipeline with best-in-class ASR, TTS, and LLM orchestration, integrated into the same platform where many of our customers already manage their front, middle, and back-office workflows. For those that don't, the voice agent is often the tip of the spear that brings them in. We compete directly against well-funded AI startups and CCaaS incumbents, and we're winning.

Job Description

How We Work:

We work in pods - small, dedicated teams embedded with a single enterprise customer, building their voice agents from first call to self-sufficiency. A pod owns the full lifecycle: agent shadowing, conversation design, build, production go-live, and the handoff that makes the customer self-sufficient so the pod can move on to the next one. Each pod pairs forward-deployed engineers with a product manager who owns both the customer outcome and the product learning that comes from it.

Every PM on this team runs at least one pod directly and has visibility across others. You're in the customer's world - on their calls, in their systems, solving their problems - while simultaneously shaping what the product becomes. The learnings from your pods feed directly into the platform roadmap and into repeatable, productized assets that scale beyond any single customer.

What This Role Owns

You run two pods closely - hands-on through the full build lifecycle with two enterprise customers simultaneously, from agent shadowing through production go-live. You'll become one of the most experienced people in the company at knowing what it actually takes to ship a voice agent that works in the real world.
Your second area of focus is the tooling and intelligence layer that makes voice agents better and easier to build. This spans automated evaluation frameworks (how do we systematically measure whether a voice agent is good?), analytics (what happened on that call and why?), admin experience (how does a customer manage and improve their own agents?), and smarter agentic design patterns like deterministic procedures that give agents reliable behavior on structured tasks. You're building the infrastructure that lets this team, and eventually our customers, move faster and build better agents.

Why This And Not Somewhere Else

This role puts you directly in front of enterprise customers running production voice AI from day one. You're not waiting to earn customer exposure - it's the job. The pod model means you'll accumulate more production voice AI experience in a year than most PMs get in several, across different industries, different contact center environments, and different conversation types. At the same time, the evaluation frameworks and agentic design patterns you build have reach well beyond your own pods. This team has a direct seat at the platform table, so the tooling you create shapes how ServiceNow thinks about voice agent quality at scale.

Qualifications

What You Bring:

5+ years of product management experience, or equivalent experience in a technical role such as engineering, solutions consulting, or technical program management where you owned product outcomes.
Comfort with data and evaluation. You think naturally about how to measure whether something is working and how to build systems that do it at scale.
Experience working directly with customers or end users on technical products. You don't need enterprise sales experience, but you need to have been in the room where the work happens.
Strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand API contracts, and hold your own with engineers on system design.
An instinct for repeatable process. You see a problem solved once and immediately think about how to solve it for every customer.

Even Better

Experience with conversational AI, voice technology, or contact center operations.
Background building evaluation frameworks, QA automation, or analytics products.
Familiarity with agentic AI design patterns and how to give an AI agent reliable, structured behavior alongside open-ended reasoning.
Coding ability in any language. You won't write production code, but PMs on this team who can prototype, script, and dig into data move faster.
Experience with telephony environments: SIP, CCaaS platforms, real-time media handling.

Additional Information

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $143,200 - $243,400
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
